color.note: Onyx and Platinum carry the brand; Raspberry Plum, Pacific Cyan and Emerald are accents. Each accent keeps its hue in both themes but takes a per-theme lightness so text in it reads at 4.5:1 or better on `ground` and `surface-raised`. Source hexes: Onyx 0A090C, Platinum F0EDEE, Raspberry Plum A4036F, Pacific Cyan 048BA8, Emerald 16DB93.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background and the mark's ground: Onyx in Dark, Platinum in Light. The default surface for everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Level 1 (raised): code blocks, command blocks, callouts, panels. One step lighter than `ground` in both themes; pairs with `shadow-1`.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Level 2 (card): Card backgrounds, one step lighter than `surface-raised`, fully solid (Alex, 2026-10-04: nothing shows through a card, so ASCII art behind it never touches the text); pairs with `shadow-2`. All text and accent tokens hold 4.5:1 or better on it in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings, body copy and primary button fill: Platinum in Dark, Onyx in Light. On `ground` and `surface-raised`, 16:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs placed on an `ink` fill (primary buttons, inverted blocks).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, prompts (`$`). On `ground` and `surface-raised`: 6.9:1 or better Dark, 5.6:1 or better Light.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only; carries no meaning, so it may sit below 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders and meaningful rules. 3.3:1 or better on `ground` and `surface-raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: a solid 2px `ink` outline offset 2px from the control; full contrast on every surface.

tokens.name: shadow-hard
tokens.usage: The hard offset shadow behind a lifted (hovered) button: a solid copy of its shape, no blur. 3.3:1+ on `ground` in both themes.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Level 4 backdrop behind a Modal: `ground` at 75%, fading the page toward Onyx in Dark and Platinum in Light. The only see-through colour.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Raspberry Plum. Light is the source A4036F; Dark is lightened to read on Onyx. Errors, destructive actions, the brand's loud moments. Text on `ground`, `surface-raised` and `surface-card`: 4.6:1+ Dark, 5.9:1+ Light.

tokens.name: on-plum
tokens.usage: Text on a `plum` fill (Onyx in Dark, Platinum in Light).

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Pacific Cyan. Dark is the source 048BA8; Light is darkened to read on Platinum. Links and informational highlights. Text on `ground`, `surface-raised` and `surface-card`: 4.6:1+ Dark, 4.95:1+ Light.

tokens.name: on-cyan
tokens.usage: Text on a `cyan` fill.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Emerald. Dark is the source 16DB93; Light is darkened to read on Platinum. Success, run/confirm actions, terminal output. Text on `ground`, `surface-raised` and `surface-card`: 9.8:1+ Dark, 4.98:1+ Light.

tokens.name: on-emerald
tokens.usage: Text on an `emerald` fill.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, underlined.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state. Always paired with a word or glyph (`[ok]`, ◉).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error and destructive state. Always paired with a word or glyph (`[err]`, ✕); in Light it sits close to `success` in lightness.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The name and hero lines. One per view.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Some things are only found by those who look.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Secondary text in callouts, cards, modals and tables, usually in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, code blocks, inline code, hashes.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons (uppercased by the component), tags, nav items and codepoints. Never letterspace display type.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls and inside checkboxes; menu option padding; textarea padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside blocks and controls (command and code blocks, menu options, table cells); button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and code-block padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between paragraphs and stacked panels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap before a `heading-2`; footer padding and its bottom line.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing; cover pattern pitch.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero padding and page-level breathing room.

radius.note: Every box gets `radius-xs` (2px); buttons also get the 45-degree `cut`. Square is kept for rules and full-bleed bands; `radius-full` for shapes that echo the mark.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Rules, table cells, tabs and full-bleed bands only.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Every box: buttons (and their cut vertices), inputs, raised blocks, cards, menus, modals, keys. Reads as not quite square.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Discs, status dots and pills only, echoing the mark's rings.

tokens.name: cut
tokens.usage: Leg of the 45-degree cut on a button's bottom-right corner. Buttons only; the hover shadow shares the same cut.

shadow.note: Soft shadows for levels 1 to 3 only: short and quiet. Modals get no shadow; the `scrim` behind them does the lifting.

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Level 1 (raised) with `surface-raised`: code and command blocks, callouts.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Level 2 (card) with `surface-card`.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Level 3 (menu): Select lists, menus, popovers, with a 1px `line-strong` border on `ground`.

tokens.name: z-base
tokens.usage: Level 0 and 1: page content, raised blocks.

tokens.name: z-card
tokens.usage: Level 2: cards, when they must sit over an AsciiBackground.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky headers and toolbars.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Level 3: Select lists, menus, popovers.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Level 4: Modal and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Transient notices that must show over a modal.

mark.note: Geometry of the mark, measured from the source file (1080 units square). Rings: outer radius 110, hole 84, dot 54; centres 304 apart. Use as ratios.

tokens.name: mark-ring-diameter
tokens.usage: One fisheye unit's diameter in source units; the base for all mark ratios.

tokens.name: mark-ring-width
tokens.usage: Outer ring stroke: 26/220 of the unit diameter.

tokens.name: mark-hole-width
tokens.usage: Black gap between ring and dot: 30/220 of the unit diameter.

tokens.name: mark-dot-diameter
tokens.usage: Centre dot: 108/220 of the unit diameter.

tokens.name: mark-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between units: 84/220 of the unit diameter. Also the minimum clear space around the mark.
